sample_unit: eye-tracking recordings (children with amblyopia and controls)

links.outcome: Explanation quality (faithfulness, robustness, localization, complexity) of Gemini amblyopia classification, via Quantus
links.effect: Model accurately classified control and amblyopic subjects, including those with nystagmus, while maintaining transparency and clinical alignment; no numeric values reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Results demonstrated that the model accurately classified control and amblyopic subjects, including those with nystagmus while maintaining transparency and clinical alignment.

unlisted_practices: Feature-Guided Interpretive Prompting (FGIP) framework focused on critical clinical features to improve LLM interpretability

screen.reason: The study evaluates an explainable artificial intelligence prompt guardrail/framework (Feature Guided Interpretive Prompting) to improve transparency and faithfulness when using Gemini for pediatric ophthalmology diagnosis on eye-tracking data.
